messages.subject: NIMBLE virtual short course, 4-6 January, 2023
parts:
Hi all,

We'll be holding a NIMBLE virtual training workshop, January 4-6, each day from 8 am to 1 pm US Pacific (California) time (11am - 4pm on the US East Coast; 5pm-10pm Central European Time).

Among other topics, the workshop will cover NIMBLE basics; special methods like Bayesian non-parametrics, spatial models, and reversible jump MCMC for variable selection; and new features including Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, Laplace approximation, and automatic differentiation.  

More about topics and registration information can be found here.

Perry (for the NIMBLE development team)
